title: Relay heartbeat (topic audit.relay.heartbeat)
description: Published by each outbox relay instance for each closed hour, bucketed by the events' occurredAt hour. Reconciler check per (service, hour): stored_rows >= sum(distinctEventCount) - sum(reclaimedCount). A violation means events are missing and pages on-call. Republished retries can only cause false alarms, never hide a loss.

hour.description: Start of the occurredAt hour bucket (UTC).

publishedCount.description: Records acked by Kafka, including this instance's own retries.

distinctEventCount.description: Distinct eventIds acked by this instance.

reclaimedCount.description: Of those, rows whose lease had expired from another instance (attempts > 0), so they may also be counted in another instance's heartbeat.
